### **Description \& Requirements**


**Introduction: Career at HARMAN Automotive**


At HARMAN Automotive, we are shaping the future of connected vehicles by bringing innovative technologies from development into high\-volume manufacturing. As part of the Advanced Manufacturing Engineering Test organization, you will help implement and industrialize automotive electronics products such as Infotainment Systems, Audio Amplifiers, Telematics Control Units (TCUs), and other connected vehicle platforms.


* **Develop and implement** manufacturing test solutions that enable the successful launch of complex automotive electronics products.
* **Partner with global teams** across engineering, quality, suppliers, and manufacturing to deliver robust and efficient production processes.
* **Advance manufacturing excellence** through automation, standardization, and continuous improvement of test technologies and methodologies.
* **Support the future of mobility** by ensuring the quality and reliability of connected, intelligent, and customer\-focused automotive systems.

**What You’ll Be Part Of**


As a Regional AME Test Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping the test strategy and manufacturing test infrastructure for next\-generation automotive products. Working as an individual contributor, you will partner with cross\-functional teams across engineering, quality, manufacturing, suppliers, and global technology organizations to develop reliable, efficient, and standardized test solutions. Your work will directly impact product quality, production efficiency, and the successful launch of new technologies into manufacturing. This position is a strong fit for engineers who enjoy technical ownership, continuous improvement, and delivering innovative test solutions in a global environment.


**How You’ll Make An Impact**


* Develop manufacturing test concepts, specifications, and validation strategies that ensure product quality and support successful product launches.
* Lead the development and implementation of hardware and software solutions for test equipment, enabling reliable and efficient testing throughout the product lifecycle.
* Collaborate with product development, quality, manufacturing, and supplier teams to deliver robust test systems that meet customer, regulatory, and production requirements.
* Optimize test processes, cycle times, and test coverage to improve manufacturing efficiency, reduce quality risks, and lower operational costs.
* Drive continuous improvement by introducing new test technologies, measurement methods, and industry best practices into manufacturing operations.
* Coordinate test equipment deployment from concept through commissioning, ensuring systems are ready for prototype builds, industrialization, and serial production.
* Contribute to global engineering standards, knowledge sharing, and lessons learned activities to strengthen test engineering capabilities across HARMAN locations.

**What Makes You A Strong Fit**


* Strong understanding of manufacturing test engineering principles, including test concepts, validation methodologies, and production test systems.
* Ability to design, develop, and troubleshoot test equipment hardware and software in a manufacturing environment.
* Working knowledge of C\# programming for the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of manufacturing test applications and automation solutions.
* Solid understanding of electronics fundamentals, including analog and digital circuits, measurement techniques, signal analysis, and hardware troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of measurement techniques, data analysis, and test coverage optimization to improve product quality and manufacturing performance.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and implement sustainable corrective actions.
* Effective collaboration and communication skills to work with cross\-functional teams, suppliers, and international engineering organizations.
* Ability to independently manage technical activities, prioritize tasks, and drive results in a dynamic manufacturing environment.
* A continuous improvement mindset focused on innovation, standardization, and operational excellence.
* We see AI as an important part of how work gets done. While tools may vary, a baseline familiarity with using AI to support efficiency, problem\-solving, and quality is expected.

**Bonus Points if You Have**

* Experience with automotive electronics manufacturing and end\-of\-line test systems.
* Familiarity with industrial test platforms, automated measurement equipment, or fixture development.
* Knowledge of statistical methods such as MSA, capability analysis, or process performance evaluation.
* Experience working with international suppliers and global engineering teams.
* Understanding of automotive quality standards and processes, including IATF 16949 requirements.

**Things To Know**


* This role is based in Székesfehérvár, Hungary and supports global automotive manufacturing and engineering activities.
* Occasional domestic and international travel may be required to support suppliers, manufacturing sites, and engineering teams.
* Professional working proficiency in English is required to collaborate effectively with global engineering and business partners.
* This role requires close cooperation with cross\-functional teams, including Product Development, Quality, Manufacturing, Purchasing, and external suppliers.
* The position involves supporting both new product introductions and serial production environments, requiring flexibility and effective prioritization of activities.

**What You Can Expect**


* A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in\-person collaboration, with most office\-based roles onsite three days a week.
* Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others)
* Learning and development opportunities through our award\-winning HARMAN University programs
* Wellness benefits designed to support your overall well\-being
* Tuition reimbursement support
* Access to the HARMAN campus fitness center and cafeteria, where available
* An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development.
* The opportunity to work on advanced automotive technologies and products used by leading global vehicle manufacturers.
* A collaborative international environment with strong connections across engineering, manufacturing, and innovation teams.
* Continuous learning opportunities through technical training, global knowledge\-sharing initiatives, and professional development programs.
* The ability to influence manufacturing standards, test strategies, and future technology roadmaps.
* A culture focused on innovation, teamwork, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence.

The Specialist Digitalization Engineer (Greenfield) is responsible for leading and coordinating digital engineering, information management, smart asset, and digital transformation initiatives during the execution of the Offshore Project. The role ensures seamless integration of digital tools, engineering data, asset information models, digital twin solutions, and operational readiness requirements throughout the project lifecycle from FEED through EPC, commissioning, start\-up, and handover.


The position plays a critical role in establishing ADNOC's digital asset foundation and ensuring that all engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning data are structured and delivered to support future operations, maintenance, reliability, and asset performance management.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **Digitalization Strategy \& Governance**


* Develop and implement project digitalization strategies in line with ADNOC Offshore standards and digital transformation objectives.
* Define digital engineering requirements, workflows, data standards, and governance frameworks.
* Ensure compliance with ADNOC Information Management and Digitalization requirements.
* Establish project digital execution plans and monitor implementation across EPC contractors and vendors.

### **Digital Engineering \& Information Management**


* Lead implementation of Digital Engineering and Smart Asset methodologies for greenfield offshore facilities.
* Ensure engineering data, vendor data, and project documentation are captured in accordance with project information standards.
* Develop and maintain Project Information Models (PIM) and Asset Information Models (AIM).
* Define metadata standards, data taxonomy, coding structures, and information classification schemes.
* Manage engineering information throughout the project lifecycle.

### **Digital Twin \& Smart Asset Development**


* Support implementation of Digital Twin and Smart Asset initiatives for offshore platforms and associated facilities.
* Ensure design and engineering deliverables are suitable for Digital Twin deployment and lifecycle management.
* Coordinate integration of engineering models, operational data, and maintenance information.
* Support digitization of asset performance and operational readiness requirements.

### **Systems Integration**


* Coordinate integration between:
	+ Engineering design systems
	+ Document management systems
	+ Asset management systems
	+ Maintenance management systems
	+ Process control and automation systems
	+ Data analytics and reporting platforms
* Ensure effective transfer of engineering information from EPC contractors to ADNOC operational systems.
* Facilitate interoperability between engineering software platforms and digital asset solutions.

### **Data Quality \& Governance**


* Establish project data quality requirements and validation processes.
* Conduct periodic audits and assessments of digital deliverables.
* Monitor completeness, consistency, and accuracy of engineering and asset data.
* Manage data cleansing, validation, and migration activities.

### **Construction, Commissioning \& Handover Support**


* Ensure digital deliverables are aligned with construction and commissioning requirements.
* Support development of asset registers and equipment master data.
* Coordinate digital asset readiness activities during commissioning and start\-up phases.
* Lead preparation and verification of digital handover packages to operations.
* Validate final data delivery and operational information readiness.

### **Analytics \& Reporting**


* Develop digital performance dashboards and project reporting tools.
* Monitor digitalization KPIs and project information maturity.
* Support analysis of engineering and operational data.
* Generate management reports related to digital transformation progress.

### **Cybersecurity \& Compliance**


* Support implementation of cybersecurity requirements for digital systems.
* Ensure compliance with ADNOC digital governance frameworks and industry best practices.
* Participate in project audits, assurance reviews, and digitalization assessments.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

jobs.title: Software Tester (Unit Test/AtlassianToolchain) - Contractor
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Software Tester to join a multi-disciplinary engineering team delivering safety- and mission-critical software for the maritime defence sector. You will be embedded with the various development teams, working at the code level as well as the system level, and taking ownership of the unit and integration test estate across both Windows and Linux targets.

This is a first hand role for a tester who is comfortable in the codebase. As well as designing and executing tests, you will strengthen the test tooling, keep automated test execution running reliably in the CI pipeline, and ensure that test evidence is traceable from requirement through to result within the Atlassian toolchain.

The successful candidate will work on site at our Rugeley, Staffordshire facility, alongside software engineers, systems engineers, and quality assurance colleagues.

Key Responsibilities

Design, write, review, and maintain unit tests for new and legacy code, working to agreed coverage and quality targets.
Develop and maintain integration and regression test suites that execute automatically on both Windows and Linux build agents.
Analyse requirements and design documentation to derive test cases and maintain bidirectional traceability from requirement to test case to result.
Own the test management workflow in Jira — including test issue types, workflows, boards, and reporting — and keep test artefacts current in Confluence.
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (Bitbucket Pipelines, Bamboo or Jenkins), diagnose pipeline failures, and keep the build green.
Investigate, reproduce, and clearly document defects; triage them with developers and track them to closure.
Produce test plans, test specifications, test reports, and evidence packs suitable for internal review and customer acceptance.
Measure and report on code coverage, test pass rates, and defect trends, and recommend improvements where quality risk is emerging.
Support code reviews with a testability and quality perspective and coach developers on effective unit testing practice.
Contribute to continuous improvement of test strategy, tooling, and process across the programme.
Work within the organisation’s configuration management, information security, and quality management procedures always.

Essential Skills And Experience

Testing

Demonstrable commercial experience as a software tester, test engineer, or SDET on a software development team.
Strong practical experience of unit testing and test-driven development, using frameworks such as Google Test, Catch2, CppUnit, NUnit, xUnit, MSTest, JUnit or pytest.
Ability to read, write and debug code in at least one of C++, C#, Java, or Python to write meaningful tests and reproduce defects.
Experience with mocking and test-double frameworks (for example Google Mock, Moq, Mockito, unittest.mock).
Working knowledge of code coverage and static analysis tooling (for example gcov/lcov, OpenCover, SonarQube, Coverity, Polyspace).
Experience designing test cases from written requirements and maintaining requirements-to-test traceability.
Sound defect management practice — clear reproduction steps, severity assessment, evidence capture and closure verification.

Atlassian suite

Firsthand experience with Jira, including creating and configuring boards, workflows, issue types, filters, and dashboards.
Experience with a Jira test management application such as Xray, Zephyr Scale or TestRail integration.
Confluence authoring — test plans, test specifications, procedures, and structured technical documentation.
Bitbucket for source control, branching strategy, pull requests and code review.
Experience configuring and troubleshooting automated builds and test stages in Bamboo, Bitbucket Pipelines.

Platforms and tooling

Confident working across both Windows and Linux — command line, scripting, filesystem, permissions, and services on each.
Scripting for test automation and environment setup (PowerShell, Bash, and/or Python).
Familiarity with cross-platform build systems and toolchains (CMake, MSBuild, make, GCC/Clang, MSVC).
Comfortable setting up and maintaining test environments, including virtual machines and containers.
Git fluency — branching, merging, rebasing, and resolving conflicts.

Desirable Skills

Prior experience in defence, maritime, aerospace, nuclear, rail or another safety- or security-critical regulated domain.
Awareness of relevant standards and practice such as DO-178C, IEC 61508, MISRA C/C++, or Def Stan 00-055/00-056.
ISTQB Foundation (or higher) certification, or equivalent formal test qualification.
Experience testing embedded, real-time, sensor or signal-processing software.
Experience of hardware-in-the-loop or rig-based testing, and of testing against simulated data sets.
Exposure to test automation at system level (for example Robot Framework, Squish, Selenium, or bespoke harnesses).
Experience of formal verification and validation activities and customer witness testing.
Familiarity with Atlassian administration, including permission schemes and app configuration.

Note: All candidates must meet the security vetting requirements relevant to the role. For reasons of national security, applicants must be British nationals. Dual nationals may be permitted in exceptional circumstances.
